setting: You are all in Hamburg, Germany, and you know each other through the wedding of Lena and Jonas. Lena and Ida have been close friends since secondary school, and Jonas, Ben and David knew each other from their Hamburg school days. Anna became part of the group through Lena's work and their shared Saturday running club. Everyone sees each other regularly, and the chat is where you coordinate the wedding plans.
openers: Post a photo of the seating plan draft
Ask who still needs to send their dress size
Share the link to the shared wedding playlist
Thank everyone for coming to the tasting last weekend
opener: Ask who still needs to send their dress size

Lena.knows: You know Jonas as your fiancé, Ida as your oldest friend from school, Ben and David as Jonas's friends from school whom you have known for years, and Anna as a friend you met through your work and your running club.
Lena.texts: Lena texts in this chat only now and again.
Lena.style: Uses a fair amount of emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Jonas.texts: Jonas texts in this chat now and then.
Jonas.style: Uses some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Ida.texts: Ida texts in this chat a lot.
Ida.style: Uses a little emoji and almost no texting abbreviations.

Ben.texts: Ben texts in this chat only now and again.
Ben.style: Uses light emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Anna.texts: Anna texts in this chat only now and again.
Anna.style: Uses some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Lena: You work as a graphic designer at a small studio in Altona, mostly on branding and print projects, and you run on weekend mornings. You live with Jonas in a third-floor flat in Eimsbüttel.
private_lines.Jonas: You teach music at a secondary school in Hamburg, giving piano and choir lessons, and you play in an amateur jazz band on some evenings. You live with Lena in a flat in Eimsbüttel, where you share a small studio room for practice.
private_lines.Ida: You work as a journalist for a Hamburg newspaper, covering local news and features, and your hours vary, often finishing late. You live alone in a flat in Sankt Pauli and spend your free time reading and going to concerts.
private_lines.Ben: You work as an IT consultant, mostly remotely from home for different clients, and you go to the gym on weekday evenings. You live alone in a flat in Winterhude.
private_lines.Anna: You work as a junior lawyer at a firm in the city centre, handling contract and employment cases, and you run with a club on weekend mornings. You live alone in a flat in Barmbek.
private_lines.David: You work as a database administrator for a logistics company in Hamburg, keeping systems running and occasionally handling on-call support. You live alone in a flat in Wandsbek and spend your free time cycling and playing board games.

text: Hi ihr 🙈 quick q: who still needs to send their dress size to the bridal shop? Need to order by friday

Bridesmaids + ida (you're in the list already, just need your measurements confirmed) and anna 🙏
jonas stay out of here lol
I'm not even in the dress chat 😂 I'm just here as a spy
I'm sending mine tonight, the link is the one from the email right?
Yes! [link: bridal shop size form]
Ok thanks
Honest question, do they want EU size or the one on the label? I have two sizes in my head and neither is right
EU please, there's a conversion chart in the form 😊
i thought this was the suit fittings chat. not dress. ignore me
not me
Sorry, was stuck at a council meeting that ran way over. Sending mine now
Thanks ida 🥰 no rush, it's not due till friday
Boring chat 😴 goodnight ladies
Done, sent. Hopefully I didn't put the wrong number 😅
Thanks anna 🙏 they'll email if something's off, don't stress
Gonna crash now 😴 night
Anna it's fine, I checked the chart against mine. The shop's been doing this for years
Ok good, thanks ida
does the shop deliver or do we pick up
Think it's delivery to the address on the form? Didn't read it properly, sorry, I'm wrecked
Morgen 🙈 yes delivery to ours, it's on the form under address. So someone needs to be home for it? Or can they leave it with the neighbour
Neighbour is the one with the dog that barks at the post 😂 I'll be at school till 4 so we're not getting it before then
Do I need to be in when it arrives or does it go to the box
Not sure tbh 🤷‍♀️ I'll check the email from them later and tell you
i'm on call this week so might drop off mid-chat if something breaks at work
Morning. Sorry, slept through the alarm 😩 So delivery to Lena's address, yes?
Jonas you're not on the list so don't worry
👍 I'm not on any list. I'm the groom
Was out at the bank, just seen this. I'm home all week if anyone needs a signature. Suit fitting is still Thursday right? Not dress 😅
Yes suit fitting thu 🙈 ben is correct for once
Lena I just saw the email. It says they email if the measurements don't match the chart. Mine matched so I think I'm ok?
Yes you're fine 🥰 they only email if they need something 🙏
Ok good. Going into a meeting now, back late. Don't wait up 😅
Did anyone else get an email from the florist or just me
Haven't checked yet 🙈 forward it to me?
It's the one about the peonies, they're out of the white ones
can someone confirm suit fitting is 10:30 or 11. the email says one and the calendar says the other
10:30 I think 🤔 the calendar one is the one I made
something's down at work. might be a while
Get well soon server 😂
Lena the peonies, do we need to decide today or can it wait till the weekend
Weekend is fine 🥰 they have till friday to tell us
Home. The meeting turned into a whole thing. Reading the florist email now
Ranunculus would be fine too if anyone's asking
Who's asking 😅
Nobody yet. Just putting it out there
back. it was the backup job again
You are the reason I have no sleep 😴
should be fine now, they re-ran it
Respect 🫡 go to bed
soon. on call till 7 so might be on and off
Looked at the peony photos on the florist site. The white ones look a bit grey tbh
Grey is the wrong word, more cream
Cream. Ok. Still putting ranunculus out there as backup, not pushing it 😅
Morgen 🙈 just reading back. I'll look at the photos later
[photo: florist site, white peonies vs cream peonies]
Left one is grey, right one is cream. Can confirm, I'm a professional 🎹
😂 ok right one
still on call. server's stable. coffee
Morning. Slept till 8 for once 😩 Did the shop email anyone yet about the dress?
Not yet 🤷‍♀️ will say if they do
does anyone know if we need our own shoes for the fitting thu or do they have some

Just the suits 🙈 you're all fine. The dress shop emailed though, dress is ordered, delivery in 2-3 weeks 🥰
Wow that was quick. Glad. Did they say which week
Not yet, they'll send a date
Year 9 just asked me if I'm nervous. I said about the peonies
They looked confused
back on the sofa. still on call till 7am so phone on the table
ben did you get the shoes sorted
yes david. thanks for checking
The council meeting was about bike lanes on the Reeperbahn. Four hours. I am going to die
Anyone want the quote I got? "We will look at it in the spring." That's the whole result
That's so typical 😅 Hope the article at least comes out ok
It's fine. Writing it now. Probably 900 words of "we will look at it"
Ok I'm going with the ranunculus if nobody objects. Ida you've convinced me. Lena can say no tomorrow
No objection from the groom 😌
not sure what I'm objecting to but no objection
just pick something anna 😂
Ok. Ranunculus. Sending the florist a message in the morning 🙈
Thanks anna. Article sent. Now I'm going to bed and I will think about the bike lanes in my sleep
god help you
Night 🙈
Morgen 🙈 just reading back. Ranunculus is fine 🥰 I'm not fighting over flowers
Great 😅 will message the florist after my run
Morning. Ranunculus! 🙌 Anna you did it
Suit fitting 10:30 for me as well. Choir ends at 9 so I should make it
10:30 yes. shoes in the bag
off call. server's stable. going to sleep. do I need to bring anything to the fitting or just me
just you. and shoes
Editor wants the bike lane piece cut to 600 words. Honestly a relief
